warmup.description: Gently mobilize the whole body while connecting breath to movement.
movements: Supine breathing with arm reaches x 6 slow breaths
Shoulder rolls and arm circles x 30s each

main_exercises.name: Spinal mobility flow (roll down to roll up transitions)
main_exercises.form_cue: Articulate through each vertebra, moving slowly with breath.

main_exercises.name: Glute and hamstring activation (bridge variations)
main_exercises.form_cue: Lift hips with control, keeping knees aligned and core gently engaged.

main_exercises.name: Upper body stability (modified push-up flow)
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep elbows soft and shoulders stable as you lower and press.

main_exercises.name: Standing balance and coordination
main_exercises.form_cue: Move slowly and maintain balance by engaging the core and focusing gaze.

main_exercises.name: Integrated core flow (dead bug to tabletop transitions)
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep movements controlled and avoid arching the lower back.

cooldown.description: Relax the body and lengthen muscles with slow, mindful stretching.
movements: Full body stretch with deep breathing x 90s

phase_notes.menstrual: This slow, full-body session is well suited here—focus on comfort and gentle movement, especially in spinal articulation.
phase_notes.follicular: Use this session to build coordination and slightly expand range of motion where it feels natural.
phase_notes.ovulatory: You may feel more mobile and balanced—explore slightly deeper ranges and smoother transitions between movements.
phase_notes.early_luteal: Maintain steady pacing and focus on clean, controlled movement throughout the session.
phase_notes.late_luteal: Keep movements soft and fluid—prioritize relaxation and avoid pushing range or intensity.
